question: Will Brent stay above $110 this week, yes or no?
hook_lines: US orders staff out of Saudi

lines.text: Oil has passed one hundred and ten dollars a barrel after new attacks on Saudi Arabia.
And the US has ordered non-emergency staff and their families to leave the country.
lines.note: State Department, via CBS, Al Jazeera

lines.text: Brent reached one hundred and ten dollars sixty three this morning, The National says.
Saudi Arabia says air defences stopped a drone aimed at the Shaybah oilfield.
lines.note: Saudi Energy Ministry, via The National

lines.text: Shaybah pumps about a million barrels a day. Operations were not affected, it says.
Hours later, Saudi officials say an attack hit Dammam's King Fahd airport.
lines.note: Saudi civil aviation, via The National

lines.text: Washington says the order covers Saudi Arabia only.

scene.quote: non-emergency U.S. government employees and their family members in Saudi Arabia only

lines.text: Other US embassies in the region have cut staff, CBS reports.
CBS says Houthi drones have targeted Saudi airports and oil sites. Iran denies any role.
Iran's Revolutionary Guards say seven vessels were hit near Hormuz.
They say four tankers caught fire and three hit mines.
Reuters says the claims are not independently confirmed.
Day two hundred and thirty eight tomorrow. Will Brent stay above one hundred and ten dollars this week, yes or no?
